selection: All 149 supplied universities plus 20 liberal arts colleges. Includes NCAA Divisions I, II and III. The supplied approximate total enrollments and unsourced ranking numbers are retained only as input provenance, not used in gameplay.
ranking: CollegeGuessr Academic Outcomes Index: 65% six-year bachelor graduation rate + 35% full-time retention rate. Ordinal positions are relative to this selected pool, not a published national ranking. The guessed college’s ordinal position is displayed in gameplay.
enrollment: Undergraduate enrollment only, Fall 2023: IPEDS DRVEF2023 EFUG, independently cross-checked against EF2023A EFALEVEL=2 EFTOTLT for every school
graduation: IPEDS DRVGR2023 GBA6RTT: six-year bachelor graduation rate
retention: IPEDS DRVEF2023 RET_PCF: full-time retention rate
athletics: Official NCAA primary all-sports conference, 2026–27; includes jointly operated Claremont-Mudd-Scripps and Pomona-Pitzer athletics
missing: Every selected school has verified comparison metrics. Outcomes reflect student mix and resources and are not a comprehensive measure of academic quality.
